Reef diving

Make room for Coron's reef side.

There's more to a diving visit than shipwrecks. Ask about reef-diving options and a day shaped around your interests and experience.

Tell us what draws you underwater.

Whether you prefer a relaxed pace, underwater photography or a varied itinerary, mention it when you inquire. Wildlife encounters and visibility are never guaranteed.

Bring your questions with you.

Ask about suitable sites, likely conditions, equipment arrangements and how a reef trip can fit into the rest of your visit.

Before you inquire

For divers who want variety, a relaxed pace or time with a camera.

  • Your certification and recent dives
  • What you enjoy underwater
  • Preferred dates
  • Equipment you plan to bring or rent
